instructions: Use Faber to publish durable artifacts and reuse accessible team knowledge. For a report or document, default to a polished, self-contained static HTML artifact unless the user requests another format. Make HTML easy to read: lead with a clear title and short orientation; use semantic HTML and a clear heading hierarchy; use responsive layout; and include a compact sidebar in every artifact (anchored navigation for multi-section reports, or a concise context/summary panel for short ones). Preserve substantive facts and caveats. Keep artifacts portable and private: do not use JavaScript, external CSS, network requests, remote fonts, or external assets, and never include secrets, raw transcript text, or private session details. These HTML and sidebar guidelines do not apply to code, datasets, or an explicitly requested alternate format.

tools.name: faber_attach_knowledge
tools.title: Attach private knowledge to a Faber artifact
tools.description: Attach distilled private session knowledge to a publication when requested by knowledge_action or needed for recovery. The attachment waits for the exact published artifact version, does not create a version, and is first-write-wins.

distilled_knowledge.description: Private session knowledge in Markdown with non-empty Outcome, Decisions and Rationale, Reusable Knowledge, and Verification headings.

publication_ref.description: Publication reference returned by faber_publish_artifact. Faber resolves it to the exact artifact version, including while publication is still pending.

tools.name: faber_context
tools.title: Get grounding context for a task
tools.description: Assemble a grounding pack for a task you're about to perform: the team's relevant prior artifacts, decisions, skills, and conventions. Call this at the START of a substantive task (building, writing, designing, debugging) with a one-line task description. Apply any recalled skills/conventions to your work, and save the result back to Faber with derived_from lineage.

task.description: What you're about to do, in one line.

tools.name: faber_get_artifact
tools.title: Get artifact source from Faber
tools.description: Fetch one accessible version of a Faber artifact with its source and shareable provenance. Accepts a UUID or pasted Faber URL; a URL with ?version=N always fetches that exact checkpoint. Private session knowledge is not returned. Use update_of when revising the same artifact and derived_from plus derived_from_version for distinct work.

id.description: Artifact UUID from Faber search, or a pasted Faber artifact URL.

tools.name: faber_mark_used
tools.title: Record artifact reuse
tools.description: Record that an accessible Faber artifact materially influenced the current work.

tools.name: faber_publish_artifact
tools.title: Publish artifact to Faber
tools.description: Publish one completed local UTF-8 artifact file to Faber. Pass its absolute path in content_ref. Do not prepare or pass distilled_knowledge; Faber captures bounded session context only after snapshot acceptance. Faber validates the file and durably stores an encrypted snapshot before returning. A completed delivery returns the artifact URL; a slower delivery returns publication_ref within ten seconds and continues in the background. If workspace selection is required after publication_ref exists, ask the user to choose and resume the same accepted snapshot with faber_publish_status; never call faber_publish_artifact again for that publication. Reports are private to the publishing user by default. Surface the artifact URL or receipt before following any returned knowledge_action.

title.description: Short human title. Omit to let Faber name it.

type.description: Product class describing what the artifact is. Defaults to document.

model.description: Exact generating model id when known.

conversation_ref.description: URL or opaque id of the originating conversation.

external_ref.description: Stable client id for this artifact so later saves append versions.

update_of.description: Faber artifact id when the user asks to amend the same report.

derived_from.description: Parent artifact id when this is distinct work derived from prior work.

derived_from_version.description: Exact parent checkpoint version consumed when creating derived work.

workspace_name.description: Exact workspace name selected by the user when Faber asks where to publish.

workspace_slug.description: Workspace slug selected only when Faber reports duplicate workspace names.

content_ref.description: Absolute path to one local UTF-8 artifact file of at most 20 MiB. For a newly generated artifact, default to a uniquely named file under ~/.faber/staging. For an existing artifact, pass its original path directly from any local directory. Faber stores an encrypted local outbox snapshot until delivery; it never moves, rewrites, changes permissions on, or deletes the source file. Do not pass directories, symlinks, credential locations, or files containing secrets.

tools.name: faber_publish_status
tools.title: Check Faber publication
tools.description: Check or resume one durably accepted local publication. Pass the original publication_ref. When Faber requests workspace selection, add the exact workspace_name or requested workspace_slug here; this resumes the original encrypted snapshot and never creates a second publication.

workspace_name.description: Exact displayed workspace name used to resume a workspace_required publish.

workspace_slug.description: Displayed workspace slug used to resume only when names are duplicated.

tools.name: faber_recall
tools.title: Recall the team's knowledge
tools.description: Retrieve the team's most relevant saved knowledge (docs, decisions, skills, pipelines, dashboards) for a topic BEFORE you start working on it. Returns grounding context — summaries + relevant excerpts + artifact ids — not just links. Use it to avoid re-deriving what the team already knows, follow existing conventions, and cite prior work. If you build on a recalled artifact, pass its id as derived_from when saving.

query.description: The topic or question to ground on, in natural language.

tools.name: faber_retry_knowledge
tools.description: Retry failed background knowledge generation for an already completed local publication while its encrypted session handoff is still retained. This never republishes or versions the artifact.

tools.name: faber_search
tools.title: Search the Faber library
tools.description: Search the team's library of saved AI artifacts. Use this BEFORE generating something the team may already have — dashboards, components, docs — and to find an artifact the user refers to by name or topic.

query.description: What to look for, in natural language.
